workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Finished parallel tool calls are recorded as "Skipped" (steer) or "interrupted" (cancel), so completed sub-agent work disappears from history
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: preserve completed parallel tool results. Target files: agent/protocol/agent_stream.py, tests/test_parallel_tool_calls.py. - Preserve results from parallel tool calls that already finished when a steer or cancellation arrives. - Keep mixed turns sequential so steering and cancellation checkpoints remain aligned with actual execution order. (Ref: https://github.com/zhayujie/CowAgent/pull/3926)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] `cow install-browser` crashes on Linux when there is no `sudo` binary (FileNotFoundError)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: do not require sudo to run `cow install-browser`. Target files: cli/commands/install.py, tests/test_cli_install_browser_sudo.py. Stops `cow install-browser` from aborting on systems without a `sudo` binary — e.g. the official Docker image, where the process is already root. (Ref: https://github.com/zhayujie/CowAgent/pull/3744)
